The `date` field in the front matter drives the sort order on the index page, so it isn't merely decorative.
Use `YYYY-MM-DD`.

Posts are ordinary `.qmd` files — everything available elsewhere on the site works here too: R chunks, math, cross-references, and links to [Projects](../projects/index.qmd) pages.
